name: Lovelove Choukyou Futago Shimai
original_name: ら・ぶ・ら・ぶ・調教 ふたご姉妹
source: One day, Kengo's father comes back home with twin sisters. According to him they are his friend's daughters and they had some circumstances, that they'll live together with them from now on. Shortly after, living together with twins takes an interesting turn for Kengo...
translation: 有一天，健吾的父亲带着双胞胎姐妹回到家。据他说，她们是他朋友的女儿，她们有一些情况，从现在开始就和她们住在一起。不久之后，与双胞胎一起生活对健吾来说发生了有趣的转变……
